notes.title: September 26, 2025 – Day 2 Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today’s update mainly addresses error issues on SteamDeck and improves overall game stability. In addition, we have fixed the following:
1. Fullscreen clipping logic issue
2. Replay playback error (after the update, you will no longer be able to skip dialogue with the Enter key, please use the Shot key instead)
3.Score storage error when exceeding 10 digits
4.Error occurring during loading

Many players are also concerned about whether there will be future content updates. The answer is yes—the story is not yet finished, and we will continue developing the upcoming chapters. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: September 25, 2025 – Day-One Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After much hard work, we’ve made progress with optimization. The day-one update includes improvements addressing most of the previous stuttering issues. Please update and log back into the game to experience the changes. Thank you for your understanding!
In addition, this update has also optimized the stability of exclusive full-screen mode.

notes.title: Notice on Stuttering / Frame Drops & Update
notes.content: [p]Thank you for purchasing the game! We’re actively investigating all reported issues. For stuttering and frame-drop cases, we’ve confirmed that [b]in the vast majority of reports the system’s discrete (dedicated) GPU was not properly engaged.[/b][/p][p]If you experience similar symptoms, please check whether your discrete GPU is enabled/assigned for the game. If you’re unsure how to do this, search for “how to force a game to use the discrete GPU.”[/p][p]In the latest update, we also added an in-game hint that requests the OS to use the discrete GPU, which we hope will help.[/p]

notes.title: Final Update Notes for the Demo
notes.content:
The limited-time free demo will end on March 3rd. We have collected many valuable feedbacks and made numerous modifications. We thank you all for your support! This will be the final update. For those who haven't had the chance to try the game yet, please be mindful of the deadline.

[Update Contents]
1. Added option settings for character body size
2. Allowed short-time judgment for "Kesshi" (desperate attack) and release of normal Spell Cards when consume 1 Spell Card resource is available
3. Slightly increased the damage of player character Spell Cards

notes.title: Day 15 Update and Apology Notice
notes.content:
We sincerely apologize for the item resource shortage caused by the Day 13 update. We have made initial fixes and adjustments to address this issue. We will further resolve the current resource imbalance in the final version. Thank you for your understanding and support!

[Experience Issues]
1. Increased initial Spell Card resources from 2 to 3
2. Readjusted conditions for BOSS Spell Card reward resources
3. Distinguished warning line sound effects from laser sound effects
4. Continued adjusting the difficulty of some bullet patterns
5. Adjusted the distribution of reward resources for elite enemies

[Localization Issues]
1.Corrected misused kanji in Japanese text

notes.title: Day 14 Update Notes
notes.content:
[Bug Fixes]
1. Continue to fix rep error issues
2. Fix the imbalance of Sanae's guided firepower between left and right

[Experience Issues]
1. Enhance the visibility of hit effects
2. Increase the distinction between Frenzy sound effects and hit sound effects

notes.title: Day 13 Major Update Notes
notes.content:
The NextFest is about to begin! For those who haven’t explored the game in depth yet, we’ve significantly improved the game’s stability over the past 12 days. If you didn’t have the best experience on launch day, please try again after this update. We hope it will bring you a more enjoyable experience!

[b]Key updates in this patch:[/b]
1. Adjusted the difficulty of resource acquisition, including system and boss bonus.
2. Increased the health and bullet pattern difficulty of certain enemies.
3. Added a stage selection function for level practice. You can now choose to practice “from the second half” or “from the final boss”.
4. Added localization support for Russian (currently in testing).
5. The version number has been updated to 0.82. Please note that version updates mean replays from previous versions will no longer be supported.

[b][BUG FIXES][/b]
1. Fixed an issue where the energy gauge would reset to zero when entering the next level after the Day 10 update.
2. Fixed some minor UI interaction issues.
3. Continued to fix replay (rep) errors.

[b][Experience Improvements][/b]
1. Improved the loading speed when entering the game.
2. Fixed an issue where Sanae’s homing attack would suddenly disappear under certain conditions.

notes.title: Day 10 Update Notes and Future Updates
notes.content:
After thorough debugging and testing, we have resolved most of the instability issues with rep files and added a quick playback feature (Ctrl key). If you encounter any errors after the update, please contact us promptly with detailed information about your system environment. We appreciate your cooperation!
Additionally, this update introduces screen presets and detailed settings, allowing users who are sensitive to screen colors to make adjustments for a more comfortable gaming experience.
Shortly, we plan to enhance the stage practice feature, enabling players to start from specific sections. This will allow you to skip mid-stage challenges and jump directly into boss battles if desired.
Lastly, we are excited to announce that the Russian version will be updated within a few days of the new festival launch, and Russian will be officially supported in the full version!

[Bug Fixes]
1. Further fixes for certain rep file errors.
2. Resolved issues with some UI displays and interactions.
3. Fixed an issue where the Rampage State was not immediately canceled when being hit.

[Experience Improvements]
1. Added screen presets and detailed settings.
2. Optimized the usability of the record and replay save screens.
3. Added a quick playback feature for rep files (hold down the Ctrl key during playback).
4. Enhanced the performance of the Sanae character.
5. Improved the visual effects of certain bullet patterns.

notes.title: Day 4 Update Notes
notes.content:
We’ve made progress on the rep issues and fixed the inconsistency in Mokou’s unit during the early stages. The remaining issues will be resolved soon.

notes.title: Day 2 Update Notes
notes.content:
We’re working hard to fix some of the issues with reps based on your feedback. Thank you for your patience and understanding while we sort things out!

[Gameplay Updates]
1、Added a "Manual" button on the title screen.
2、Added a fullscreen mode option. (Choosing exclusive fullscreen helps reduce input lag.)
3、Increased the damage of support cards.
4、Tweaked the animation for judgment points.

[Localization Fixes]
1、Fixed some incorrect characters in the Traditional Chinese text.

notes.title: Day 1 update has been pushed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059714/c5f326152aeaf651176dec764902e26a26a77fb7.png[/img]
Everyone's enthusiasm has given us a great surprise. At the same time, the demo version inevitably has many issues that need to be fixed and followed up on. However, our production team consists of only 3 members, and we have limited manpower, so we hope everyone can patiently wait for the issues to be resolved. Thank you very much!

Update Content:

[b]【Technical Issues】[/b]
Fixed some error issues
Fixed the issue of not being able to use win+G to bring up the Game Bar in full-screen mode
Fixed display adaptation issues for screens of various aspect ratios
Fixed the issue where refresh rate affects game speed under vertical synchronization
Fixed error issues on SteamDeck

[b]【Experience Issues】[/b]
Fixed the issue of dealing damage to invincible or hidden targets while in a Rampage state
Added a short cooldown time after the barrier is broken to prevent rapid release of spell cards
Added energy items in the tutorial stage's Frenzy state to prevent progress from being disrupted
Fixed the issue of energy not returning to the initial state after the tutorial stage
Added invincibility time for companions after the protective barrier is broken
Increased the difficulty of entering Rampage state and slightly enhanced Sanae's overall firepower

[b]【Localization Issues】[/b]
Fixed the issue of traditional Chinese appearing in simplified Chinese dialogues
Fixed some misuse issues in Japanese
